tools.name: scale_recipe
tools.description: Scale ingredients from one serving count to another. Use when you need to adjust serving sizes; NOT when you need to convert units, use convert_units.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a cooking amount between units. Use when needing exact conversions between same-dimension units; avoid when needing ingredient-specific conversions, use scale_recipe instead.

tools.name: merge_shopping_list
tools.description: Merge multiple shopping lists into one. Use this when you have several lists to consolidate. Use scale_recipe when you need to adjust ingredient amounts for a different number of servings.

tools.name: cost_per_serving
tools.description: Calculate the cost per serving of a recipe. Use when you need to understand the cost efficiency of a recipe. Do NOT use when you need to adjust the quantity of ingredients in a recipe, use scale_recipe.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scale_recipe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Scale every ingredient of a recipe from one serving count to another, with friendly kitchen measures and items without a quantity passed through." → after: "Scale ingredients from one serving count to another. Use when you need to adjust serving sizes; NOT when you need to convert units, use convert_units."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
